scope: Focused read-only code/log investigation; no new sampling benchmark, native profiling or Unity control

native_observation.limit: Does not separate worker CPU, source-refresh cost, polling waits, transfer waits or GPU frame cost; discarded stale samples are not included

confirmed_code_facts: At most8 workers ×8192 samples means65536 active samples despite300000 configured cap

Upload2ms stopwatch starts before completion validation/mirror copying; a costly harvest can skip first upload in that frame

requirements: Do not early-return the runtime update or skip visible-cache publication

expected_limit: Removes hidden rendering and can shorten frame-gated bubbles, but does not reduce sample work or live-field cost; no measured speedup or promised wall time
